content_fields.title: Enforce request-body and upload size limits to resist memory-exhaustion DoS (FastAPI)
content_fields.description: Bound the size of any content the service downloads or accepts so a single request cannot exhaust process memory.
content_fields.finding: The remote image is downloaded and base64-encoded entirely in memory with no Content-Length check and no size cap.
content_fields.current_code:
def _image_url_to_base64(image_url: str):
    response = requests.get(image_url, stream=True)
    encoded_image = base64.b64encode(response.content).decode()

    return encoded_image
criteria: The download is streamed and aborts once the byte ceiling is crossed.
A declared Content-Length above the ceiling short-circuits before any body is read.
A connect and read timeout is set on the outbound request.
